usedFor: Content Workflow Bynder tracks content items, and viaSocket utilities runs another workflow with “Flow in Flow” after “Item Became Overdue”.

bestTemplate.name: “Item Became Overdue” in Content Workflow Bynder, then “Flow in Flow” in viaSocket utilities
bestTemplate.why: An overdue item can hand off to a separate workflow built to deal with it.

watchOut: “Flow in Flow” needs a flowid, the child flow’s script id, so the second workflow must exist first.
